features.title: Platform foundation, access control and availability
features.summary: Environments, CI/CD, secrets, users/boards/membership, board-member authorisation, monitoring for 99.5% availability.

features.title: Tasks and board with live updates
features.summary: Task CRUD, three-column board, drag to move, SSE live updates within 5 s, keyboard accessibility.

features.title: Full-text task search
features.summary: PostgreSQL full-text search over titles and descriptions of the user's boards, p95 under 300 ms at 10,000 tasks.

features.title: Comments and @mentions
features.summary: Comment on tasks, mention teammates with @name, mention triggers notification.

features.title: Assignment email notification
features.summary: Email to assignee within 1 minute of assignment via notify-worker and email provider API.

features.title: Daily due-tomorrow digest
features.summary: Daily digest email of tasks due tomorrow at 08:00 in the user's time zone.

features.title: Notification preferences
features.summary: Per-user notification preferences: channel and frequency (channels/frequencies undecided).

features.title: Burndown report and CSV export
features.summary: Per-board burndown chart of remaining story points per sprint day; CSV export of a board.
